summary.goal: Extend MCP tools so agents can read and write understanding and specification sections programmatically
summary.context: Agents need MCP tools to contribute observations (understanding) and refine specs (specification) during planning sessions. This enables organic, agent-driven planning.

acceptance_criteria.description: get_plan tool response includes understanding and specification when present
update_understanding tool adds/updates observations for a specific role
update_step_specification tool adds/updates a specific domain spec for a step
Tools validate against Zod schemas, return clear errors on invalid input
Tools work with plan_id + version, fail gracefully if plan not found
PlannerLead can use tools to populate understanding from conversation analysis

steps.title: Update get_plan tool response
steps.description: Ensure get_plan MCP tool returns understanding and step specifications

acceptance_criteria.description: get_plan response includes version.understanding
get_plan response includes version.steps[].specification
Response shape documented in tool description

steps.title: Add update_understanding MCP tool
steps.description: Create MCP tool for updating understanding observations

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool name: update_understanding

Input schema: { plan_id: string, role: string, observations?: string[], keywords?: string[], questions?: string[], concerns?: string[], references?: string[], confidence?: 'exploring'|'forming'|'confident' }
Calls PATCH /plans/:id/understanding/:role internally
Returns success with updated observations or error message
Tool description explains usage and when to use

steps.title: Add update_step_specification MCP tool
steps.description: Create MCP tool for updating step specifications

acceptance_criteria.description: Tool name: update_step_specification
Input schema: { plan_id: string, step_id: string, domain: 'architecture'|'design'|'testing'|'security', specification: object }
Specification object varies by domain (validated against appropriate schema)
Calls PATCH /plans/:id/steps/:stepId/specification/:domain internally
Returns success with updated spec or error message
Tool description includes examples for each domain

steps.title: Register tools in MCP server
steps.description: Register new tools in the MCP server handler

acceptance_criteria.description: update_understanding registered in tools list
update_step_specification registered in tools list
Tools appear in MCP server tool listing

steps.title: Add MCP tool tests
steps.description: Add tests for new MCP tools

acceptance_criteria.description: Test: update_understanding adds observations for new role
Test: update_understanding returns error for invalid input
Test: update_step_specification adds spec to step
Test: update_step_specification returns error for unknown step_id
Test: get_plan includes understanding and specifications

steps.title: Document tools for PlannerLead
steps.description: Update PlannerLead system prompt to include new tools usage

acceptance_criteria.description: PlannerLead system prompt mentions update_understanding tool
PlannerLead system prompt includes guidance on when to use each tool
Examples of extracting observations from conversation included
